limitations: Section-level relevance on fixed-product knowledge QA; not whole-agent routing.
Known regression and project-authored challenges, no independent human-labelled holdout.
Answer grading follows the frozen label version; v2 permits explicitly labelled optional facts.
One measured attempt per case/configuration, balanced order, concurrency one; P95 is not a production SLA.
Failures/unattempted questions remain in planned quality denominators; latency lists their coverage separately.
No invented provider token usage or billing; provider request counts are recorded separately.
Question-disjoint holdout on known source material; not source-disjoint or independently human labelled.
About eight eligible sections per question: retrieval saturation remains.
v1/v2 answer pass rates are not directly comparable because thirteen questions and the label policy changed.
Paired BM25 comparison uses the same v2 questions on identical old/new source content and makes zero provider requests.

metricDefinitions.answerPassRate: all required source paragraphs selected, optional paragraphs accepted, forbidden paragraphs excluded, insufficiency flag checked; not human semantic accuracy
metricDefinitions.recallAt5: macro required-section recall before Grader; 126 answerable cases overall, 96 regression and 30 fresh
metricDefinitions.p95Ms: nearest-rank total HTTP latency per group at concurrency 1; 4 warmups excluded; includes diagnostics
